identity_rule: Endpoint v2 identity is (scheme, normalized host, effective port, exact case-sensitive path, method). Effective port uses the explicit port or a known scheme default; unknown remains NULL. Query and fragment are sample data, not identity. Method is normalized uppercase; missing/invalid method is the distinct unknown value, never GET. No path template folding. Historical pre-v2 keys remain legacy-folded and are not reconstructed.

examples.why: Exact path and method are part of v2 identity; the numeric segment is preserved.
A distinct concrete path remains a distinct endpoint.
A distinct method remains a distinct endpoint; method is observed or declared, never inferred as GET.
Scheme and host normalize, known effective port is retained, path case remains exact, and query/fragment do not enter identity.
Different scheme gives a different identity.
HTTPS default port differs from HTTP and paths preserve case.
An explicit non-default port remains distinct.
Missing method is encoded as unknown, never converted to GET.
Query values are not endpoint identity; they remain masked sample data.

rejects.why: Empty input has no endpoint identity.
Relative path needs an explicit base.
Single-label host is not accepted as a complete domain.
